name: Iron Forge
look: a robot Heatran of crimson metal cracked with glowing magma, a bronze-ribbed chest, an angular black helmet with glowing visor lines, spiked black armoured legs and flames roaring from its back
entry: A Pokémon resembling Heatran, recorded in a report about a furnace that walked out of a valley of souls. Its magma never cools, and its visor glows brighter the longer it fights.
how: Wild: very rare in the Nether's soul sand valleys.
